scope: Frozen task-trained QA backbone; per-precision five-feature logistic heads fitted only to 256 previously observed development examples. Calibration 128 previously observed development examples. New evaluation 128 examples from four remaining public SQuAD2 articles; upstream benchmark exposure and prior project hypothesis decisions prevent model-unseen/general deployment claims. Only task-specific bounded prototype eligibility if all five fixed point gates pass; uncertainty intervals are descriptive. Separate heads mean pipeline, not pure-quantizer, comparison.
